remarks: Cozy 1 bedroom condo at "Royal Pavillion" within easy walking distance to lively downtown, shopping, theaters and restaurants, newer kitchen cabinets and countertop, wood flooring throughout. Agents please read agent remarks regarding application requirements and move-in requirements.
